title: fix(nuxt): keep a configured `appSecret` and warn when it is used
body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

<!-- Please ensure there is an open issue and mention its number. For example, "resolves #123" -->

### 📚 Description

this follows on from https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35874 and adds a bit of backwards compatibility in case some developer has `NUXT_APP_SECRET` already set. it avoids overwriting it and warns at point-of-use only.
